17 March 2026

Monetary policy decisions

The Governing Council decided today to lower all three key ECB interest rates.

Key ECB interest rates

The Governing Council decided to lower the deposit facility rate by 25 basis points to 1.50 per cent.

In addition, the interest rate on the main refinancing operations was reduced to 1.75 per cent.

The marginal lending facility rate was cut by 25 basis points to 2.00 per cent.

These rates will apply with effect from 25 March 2026.

European Central Bank, 2026
